verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs describe an invisible CAPTCHA that protects against sophisticated bots without user-facing challenges, and say it can be applied to sensitive routes as an invisible check. A firewall with managed rulesets that block scrapers and unwanted traffic backs this up. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the challenge works (setup, client/server integration, verification flow), and independent or hands-on corroboration that it blocks bots in practice.
